name: MacWhisper
summary: Mac app for local transcription of audio and video using Whisper and other speech models.
description: MacWhisper transcribes audio and video files on the Mac using OpenAI's Whisper, Qwen and NVIDIA Parakeet models running locally. It is sold on Gumroad: a free version is available, and MacWhisper Pro costs €65 for a personal licence, with volume licences for teams. Volume licences range from 5 to 50 seats at lower per-licence prices. The app runs natively on macOS, so recordings do not need to be uploaded for transcription.
